title: Filterable & Sortable User Table
description: Build a small data table that supports text filtering and column sorting. Practice the core UI pattern of showing a dataset, letting the user filter by a search box, and sorting by clicking column headers.
requirements: Render a table of users with columns: Name, Email, Role
Use React.useState to store the full list of users in component state
Use React.useState to store a text filter value
Render a text input above the table for filtering
Filter the visible rows by the search text matching Name or Email (case-insensitive)
Render clickable column headers for Name and Role that control sorting
Clicking a sortable header should toggle between ascending and descending order for that column
Show a simple visual indicator (e.g., '↑' or '↓') on the currently sorted column header
Apply filtering before sorting (i.e., sort only the filtered subset)
Do not mutate the original users array when sorting; always work on a derived copy
Export the FilterableDataTable component as the default export

browserTests.name: Sorts by name when header clicked

hints: Start by keeping the raw user data in a constant and copy it into state if you need to.
Use two pieces of state: one for the current filter text, one for the current sort settings (field + direction).
Derive a filtered array based on the filter text, then derive a sorted array from that filtered list.
Remember that Array.prototype.sort mutates; clone the array before sorting to avoid mutating state.
